# SPORT H&N

> > Professional ski racing shop and bootfitting specialists in Reith im Alpbachtal, Tirol, serving FIS athletes and World Cup racers with expert ski tuning, custom boot fitting, and race equipment.

SPORT H&N is a specialist sportshop in the Austrian Alps offering professional bootfitting services, race ski preparation, and equipment for alpine skiing, ski touring, and summer activities. The shop serves both competitive athletes and recreational skiers with locations in Reith im Alpbachtal and Alpbach.

## Key Topics

- Bootfitting & Custom Ski Boot Fitting
- Race Ski Tuning & Preparation
- FIS & World Cup Equipment
- Reith im Alpbachtal & Alpbach Locations
- Alpine Ski Racing
- Ski Touring Equipment
- Summer Hiking & Trail Running
- Online Ski Rental
- ATOMIC, HEAD, ROSSIGNOL, FISCHER Equipment
- 3D Foot Analysis
- Race Structure & Waxing
- World Cup File Holder Kits
- Athlete Equipment Services
- Tirol Ski Shop

## Core Services

- [SPORT H&N - Sportshop, Bootfitting & Skituning Experte](https://sport-hun.at): Homepage for SPORT H&N ski racing experts in Reith im Alpbachtal, Tirol
- [BOOTFITTING - Sport H&N](https://sport-hun.at/en/bootfitting): Custom ski boot fitting with 3D analysis & appointment-only service
- [SKI SERVICE - Sport H&N](https://sport-hun.at/en/skiservice): Athlete ski tuning: sidewall prep, edge filing, race structure & waxing
- [RACING - Sport H&N](https://sport-hun.at/en/racing): Race bootfitting & equipment for FIS athletes with World Cup expertise
